detector.angles: orientations folded into [0, 90) degrees; axis-aligned and 45-degree counts and single-linkage angle classes at 1e-6 radians (tight) and 0.5 degrees (loose); `tilted` is n minus the tight axis-aligned count and `tilted_loose` n minus the loose one, so their difference is squares drifted off the axes by less than half a degree
detector.axis_grid: tight axis-aligned squares; components join squares sharing a full face within 0.001; a square is on a corner's lattice when its distances to that corner's two walls are half-integers within 1e-06

small.tested: side - m against a + b*sqrt(2); b = 0 is the plain rationals

wide.tested: only when the small library misses: side against c + b*sqrt(2), c the nearest rational of bounded denominator to side - b*sqrt(2)

detector.exact_grid_caveat: exact-grid records are canonical row-major grid subsets; their arrangement, symmetry, and sharing are a convention, and only the side is evidence
detector.indices: m = floor(sqrt n), r = n - m^2; k = round(sqrt n), d = n - k^2 (nearest square, never tied); ceil_sqrt = ceil(sqrt n)

l_construction.column_break: in the left-justified column n = m^2 + j, a non-integer record whose non-integer column predecessor is not its l_parent
l_construction.l_bound: over every n' < n with n - n' = 2*floor(side(n')) + 1, the smallest side(n') + 1, its n', and margin = that bound - side(n)
l_construction.l_chain_root: l_parent followed until null; l_chain_length counts steps
l_construction.l_parent: the n' < n with n - n' = 2*floor(side(n')) + 1 and side(n) - side(n') = 1 within 1e-09, else null
l_construction.l_parent_embeds: every square of the parent reappears in n under shared_with_next's 32 alignments
l_construction.step: n' squares in side s' give n' + 2*floor(s') + 1 squares in s' + 1 (DS7 section 2), floor taken within the side tolerance

detector.same_tilt_signature_as_next: both packings tilted, with the same non-axis loose angle classes: equal counts at angles within 0.5 degrees
detector.shared_with_next: each D4 image of n, translated so one container corner is fixed as the side changes, matched against n + 1 within 0.001 and 1e-3 radians; 32 alignments, best (matched, matched_tilted) reported, tilted meaning outside the loose axis band; embeds means all n squares matched
detector.side: the manifest's reported_side; integer_side when it equals ceil_sqrt, and side equality between neighbours, within 1e-09

symmetry.rule: an element holds when every square's image has a square center within the tolerance on each axis at a matching orientation; rotations are counterclockwise, reflections negate orientation modulo 90 degrees

detector.tilted_layout: squares outside the loose axis band: the major axis of their centers' covariance on [0, 180) degrees, and the square root of the major-to-minor variance ratio as elongation

best_known_d_max.description: the largest d >= 0 with side(k^2 - d) = k within the side tolerance, read from the atlas's best-known sides: a best-known value, not a proved one

conventions.floor_square: n = m^2 + r with m = floor(sqrt n); `by_floor_remainder` and L columns
conventions.nearest_square: n = k^2 + d with k = round(sqrt n); `by_nearest_offset`, excess_table, gobel_strip_check, delta_plateau and best_known_d_max index n this way
conventions.triangle_row: row k holds n = (k-1)^2+1 .. k^2, every n with ceil(sqrt n) = k; `rows`, grid_held_width and the row_max/mid_row fields use it

delta_plateau.description: k with side(k^2 + 1) - k = 5/sqrt(2) - 3 within 1e-09, and those records' axis-aligned and 45-degree square counts at 1e-6 radians

diagonal_bands.description: records whose tilted_layout elongation is at least 5.0 with a principal direction within 10.0 degrees of a container diagonal

excess_table.description: side(k^2 + d) - k; null where k^2 + d is outside the atlas

gobel_strip_check.description: d_G(k) = 3 - k + floor((k - 2)*sqrt 2) and n = k^2 + d_G(k); whether side(n) - k = 1/sqrt(2) within 1e-09, and n's 45-degree squares
